# ContourChartElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasContourChartElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasContourChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasContourChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasContourChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasHeatmapChartElement`](UltraCanvasHeatmapChartElement.md) → [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A scalar field: isolines and filled bands, or a shaded 3D height field

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasContourChartElement> CreateContourChartElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasContourChartElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetFunction()` | `void SetFunction(const std::function<double(double, double)>& fn, int cols, int rows, double xMin, double xMax, double yMin, double yMax)` | Sample an analytic function onto a grid of the given resolution. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `ContourRenderMode`

How the field is painted.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Lines` | isolines only, no fill |
| `Filled` | filled bands only |
| `FilledWithLines` | filled bands with isolines stroked on top |
| `Smooth` | continuous (unbanded) colour fill plus isolines |
| `HeatmapWithContours` | discrete heatmap cells with isolines on top |

### enum `ContourLegendMode`

Legend presentation. Named NoLegend rather than None to dodge the X11 macro.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoLegend` |  |
| `ColorBar` | continuous vertical ramp with ticks |
| `DiscreteBands` | vertical list of swatch + interval |
| `DiscreteBandsHorizontal` | same, laid out along the bottom |

### enum `ContourLineColorMode`

How an isoline is coloured.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Fixed` | one colour for every contour |
| `FromLevel` | each contour takes its own colour from the colour map |

### enum `ContourIntervalFormat`

Text used for a band entry in the discrete legend.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Brackets` | \[0.00, 0.02\] |
| `Dash` | 0.00 - 0.02 |
| `To` | 0.00 to 0.02 |

### struct `ContourClickInfo`

Everything a click on the field can tell the application.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | `double x = 0.0` | data-space position |
| `y` | `double y = 0.0` |  |
| `value` | `double value = 0.0` | bilinear field value at (x, y) |
| `bandIndex` | `size_t bandIndex = 0` | 0 = below the first level .. levels = above the last |
